title: Design a clearer onboarding experience for a complex product
prompt: Explore onboarding concepts that help new users build confidence during the first week without creating extra support load.

tensions.summary: New users need reassurance, while the support team needs fewer repeated escalations.
tensions.preserve_reason: Optimizing only one side can make the system less useful.

tensions.summary: A simple first-run experience still needs to surface important policy constraints.
tensions.preserve_reason: Policy constraints need to stay visible while friction gets reduced.

tensions.summary: Personalization could improve confidence but may create review overhead.
tensions.preserve_reason: The concept space should retain both user confidence and governance constraints.
